| w2-agent-core follow-up 31 | D-136 confirmed with one correction: the verified deny-all candidate applies only when an Apply error is retained; the ordinary stale-lease transition installs the baseline and ACKs, renews, then Applies, verifies and heartbeats, with no finite outage ceiling. 80 desired-first generation changes measured (final population: baseline→Apply p50 / p99 173.8 / 195.6 ms; 501 sibling losses counted, 435 outside completed guards). `TestLab04_RestartKeepsVerifiedLease` failed 5 in 30 on unchanged main with leases about 3,599 s from expiry: cancelling the caller after SIGTERM manufactured Apply and member-path failures. `Engine.Step` now stops at the safe boundary, then finishes bounded local work (at most 10 s) while control I/O stays cancellable; real failures still fail closed; the lab restart requires a graceful exit. Netlab 22 request 1: the TEST ONLY lifecycle caller, only under `TestMode` and `TestTimingPath`. The design note recommends intersection serving, for the r18 review only. | done (#369) |
